notes.title: The Multi-display issue
notes.notes:
It is not work a screen mode on the Multi-display.
Please note that you will not be able to back the game after error occurs.

We are working on a fix for this.
We should have a new release in 2-3 days’ time.

I have made a note to contact you when this is ready.
Thanks for your help, and sorry for any inconvenience.
